about_the_game:
Bomberball is a sci-fi multiplayer sports game with class-based loadouts. Run, pass, and throw a planet-killer bomb into the opposing team’s rift. Coordinate formations in tightly-crafted arenas. Experience the fast-paced, strategic combat of the future.

Features

Work with your team to get the bomb into the enemy team's rift, by any means necessary. Fight for every inch in unforgiving stadiums, coordinate a playbook with your teammates, and position yourself for the perfect score!

Learn and perfect the art of controlling a physics-based ball objective with precision. Utilize fast reflexes and quick thinking in a variety of playstyles to win!

Elevate the first person athlete experience with superhuman abilities - shield, grapple, or launch your hero into action - avoid imminent danger in intense situations or assist your team!
